messages:
alex: Quick check — PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/backend/pull/4342|#4342> touches on onprem auth and a couple ENV changes. cc @mira for security review. Need this merged in the 12:00 PT deploy window if possible. What's the exposure surface for shared secrets?

mira: Looking now. Are the ENV changes adding new SA tokens or broadening KMS access?

sam: I'm the author. It's just scoping down an existing SA to read-only for models svc and adding an option to point to a local KMS endpoint in private deployments. No plaintext secrets in the diff. Updated tests.

security-bot: Secret scan started for PR #4342
Findings: 0 HIGH, 0 MEDIUM, 1 LOW (Dockerfile ARG used, not a secret)
Command: `./tools/secret-scan --pr 4342`

mira: Low is fine but need to confirm KMS policy. @jordan can you confirm the KMS role only allows decrypt/generateDataKey and not key creation or admin?

jordan: Confirmed. Current role principal allows: kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey only. No CreateKey/DeleteKey. Snippet: "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"]. Also: make sure onprem option doesn't print KMS endpoint to logs.

paula: Heads up — merge window is 12:00–12:30 PT. We need 2 reviewers + sec ack before merging. @mira can you +1 or add any blocking reqs? :clock1: 

mira: I'll +1 after one small change: remove the debug echo that prints the KMS URL.

sam: Done — removed the echo and pushed commit 8f3d. Added a unit check to scrub KMS env var from logs.

security-bot: Smoke deploy invoked: `./deploy/smoke.sh --env onprem --pr 4342` -> OK (no 500s observed)

alex: Thanks. @mira @jordan can we target merge at ~12:05 PT if there are no other blockers? I'll queue a short canary.

mira: :eyes: reviewing the latest commit now.

mira: LGTM from security — no secrets in diff, IAM scoped correctly, and logs don't leak endpoint. :white_check_mark:

paula: Two reviewers still required — @alex can you do a quick infra review or assign to infra so I can unblock merge?

alex: Doing a quick infra/acct review now, focusing on egress rules. Passing to @jordan for final network check.

jordan: Egress/network looks good for onprem topology. Approving now.

alex: Approved and merged at 12:07 PT. Will monitor canary for 15m and open rollback if needed. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
